articles.summary: Most function heads aren't asked to think strategically during the reforecast, so they don't. Three changes to how you run the cycle turn it into the moment that surfaces real strategy bottom-up.
articles.title: How to Run a Reforecast That Surfaces Real Strategy

articles.summary: The mid-year reforecast is the most expensive recurring exercise in FP&A — and most teams use it to produce an artifact when they should be producing a set of decisions.
articles.title: Why Most Reforecasts Produce a Number, Not a Decision
